dispatches.route: Sector 14 Salt Silo to Bunker 7 West Gate
dispatches.goods_manifest: 40 kg rock salt, 2 blocks refined sulfur
dispatches.transcript: Harlan: I left the salt sacks under the iron culvert at Mile 8 as agreed. Don't send that nervous boy Anton next time; he nearly shot my dog because the wind blew the brush. Send two tubs of salted mutton lard and thirty 7.62mm cartridges back with the dog's pack. If the cartridges are corroded green again, I trade the next shipment to the Garrison at Lock 4.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 silver pocket watch, 1 wool scarf, 3 dried apricots
dispatches.transcript: Marta, if you are reading this, I did not make the crossing to the south valley. The patrol had dogs on the embankment and the ice was rotten near the lock gates. Keep the scarf wrapped around the baby's chest; the wool is good. Don't believe Colonel Voss when he says the capital is still standing. The sky has been yellow for six weeks. I am so tired of running.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 2 kg real dried yeast, 500g whole black pepper
dispatches.transcript: Boris: Got your dried German brewing yeast out of the brewery cellar in town. Smells like heaven, active as a badger. It will cost you six loaves of real wheat bread and three tins of corned beef. No sawdust in the loaves, or next time I bring you dry sand instead of pepper. Meet under the bridge at 22:00 when the searchlight swings north.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Operational Intelligence
dispatches.transcript: LINE 3 VOLTAGE DROPPING FAST. ICE LOAD ON MILE 12 GUY WIRES EXCEEDS TEN TONS. CAN HEAR A CARRIER ON 1205 KHZ BUT NO MODULATION. THREE UNMARKED SKI PATROLS CROSSED THE RIDGE HEADING TOWARD SECTOR 7. THEY ARE NOT OURS. THEY WEAR WHITE BED-SHEET SMOCKS AND CARRY HEAVY PACKS. ADVISE DOUBLE SENTRY AT AIRLOCK.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 500ml 95% grain alcohol, 20 clean linen bandaging rolls
dispatches.transcript: Dr. Vel: We boiled the altar linen twice in chlorinated water. It is as sterile as stone can make it. The alcohol came from the communion cellar behind the organ. Use it for the children's burns, not the sentries' toothaches. If Voss asks, tell him we used it to cleanse the burial tools. God forgives a lie that keeps blood inside a chest.

dispatches.route: Canal Lock 2 to Bunker 7 Freight Hoist
dispatches.goods_manifest: 120 kg cured pine timber, 4 car batteries, 12 spark plugs
dispatches.transcript: Harlan: Sled broke through surface crust twice on the lake flats. Anton's left foot is frostnipped but he didn't drop the timber. The four 12V batteries are fully charged; the mechanic at Lock 2 ran them off their waterwheel alternator yesterday. We need two jars of pine needle salve and three liters of diesel fuel for the return trip.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Reward: 50 rounds 7.62mm, 5 kg dried salt pork
dispatches.transcript: REWARD: For the recovery of one draft mare (bay, white blaze, branded 'G-14' on right flank) stolen by Deserter Cpl. Reznov on Day 210. Animal must be returned alive to Garrison Outpost 3. Dead animal returned with meat intact pays half bounty. The deserter may be shot on sight.

dispatches.route: Piped down Ash Chute 4 in a Tobacco Tin
dispatches.goods_manifest: 2 pouches genuine Turkish tobacco, 1 pack rolling papers
dispatches.transcript: Fyodor: Got this off a dead officer in the Highway 9 staff car. Real leaf, dry as autumn leaves. I need four forged steel drift pins for the Sector 6 timber headers. Drop them in the bottom ash pan before the 18:00 blow-down. Don't let Master Oleg see you grinding them.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 orbital ephemeris chart, 1 notebook
dispatches.transcript: Sonya: The Harrow-4 constellation is breaking up faster than predicted. Last night through the 400mm mirror, I counted six distinct debris trails descending into the upper stratosphere. A massive tungsten penetrator impact will occur somewhere in the northern quadrant within forty days. Tell your miners to shore up the lowest limestone drifts.

dispatches.sender: Old Man Kroll (Hermit of the Slag Heaps)
dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 high-speed carbide drill bit, 3 iron can openers
dispatches.transcript: Boy: Tell your Weigher that I have three pre-war butterfly can openers stamped from hardened nickel steel. They don't bend on heavy ration tins like your tinplate junk. I will trade all three for one pound of dried split peas, half a cup of kerosene, and three boxes of matches with dry heads. No negotiations.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1.5 kg fresh wild garlic bulbs, 200g dried mint leaves
dispatches.transcript: Irina: Bed 3 produced our first full harvest of wild garlic bulbs grown in peat treated with bone ash. High allicin content; should work well for respiratory infections in Bunk 2. Please send two empty tincture bottles back so I can prepare the mint extract for the nursery.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Wire Recording Transcript
dispatches.transcript: Intercepted on 88.4 MHz Pirate Free-Net at 02:14: 'The Weigher at Bunker 7 is skimming 2% off every flour sack before stamping the seal. He stores the surplus in an unmapped floor cavity under the scale pedestal.' I checked the scale room at 04:00; there is indeed a hollow ring when tapping the mortar.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Requisition: 20 brass grommets, 5 meters vulcanizing tape
dispatches.transcript: Oleg: We are out of vulcanizing adhesive for patching the knees of the Type-2 rubber suits. Three surface scouts came back yesterday with chemical burns because the seams dissolved in the sulfur runoff at Lock 4. Send the liquid rubber cement from your gasket shelf immediately.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Dive Survey Report
dispatches.transcript: Stepan: I went down four meters into the hold of Barge Volga-6. The water is freezing but clear. The cargo is eighty barrels of cement in sealed polythene bags; the core is still dry powder! If you bring the winch sled and two air tanks tomorrow morning, we can raise fifteen barrels before the silt shifts.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 repaired diatonic accordion reed plate
dispatches.transcript: Boris: I fixed the high E-reed on your accordion with a sliver of brass from a bullet casing. It plays sweet now. If you give me two hot biscuits after the Saturday dance, I will play three waltzes and that tune about the train to Odessa that makes the old stokers weep.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 25 kg yellow sulfur flowers, 10 liters sulfuric acid
dispatches.transcript: Oleg: Enclosed is the sulfur for your vulcanizing shop and battery electrolyte production. Treat the carboys with immense care; if acid leaks on the timber sled runners, the wood will char to coal within an hour. In return, send six pairs of hardened steel pickaxe heads for our shale diggers.

dispatches.route: Hand-Delivered Note in a Dried Tea Tin
dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 sprig of dried mountain heather
dispatches.transcript: Dear Doctor: On Friday evening after the 20:00 census check, Anton and I are having Sister Mara bless our rings in the lower crypt. We have one cup of real red wine and a piece of sweet rye biscuit. Please come if your chest allows you to walk the stairs. You kept both of us alive to see this day.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Search Bulletin
dispatches.transcript: ATTENTION: 'Sapper', the 3-year-old wire-haired terrier belonging to the demolition crew, went missing during the 14:00 perimeter patrol in Sector 4. Wearing a red webbing collar with a brass washer stamped '7'. Do not shoot; dog has high radiation sniffing capability. Reward: 1 can of beef stew.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 3 hand-drawn drafting schematics on vellum
dispatches.transcript: Sonya: I finished the design for the waterwheel governor at Lock 4. If we cast the runner blades from melted railway rails at the Silent Foundry, we can generate forty kilowatts of constant AC current by spring. We will never have to haul coal down the north slope again. Look at the drawings on Sheet 2.

dispatches.route: Nailed to the Chapel Blast Door
dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 wooden cross, 1 sack of ash
dispatches.transcript: Colonel: You count rifles while the Lord counts sins. The fire that fell from heaven was not an accident of politics; it was the weighing of the nations. Disarm your sentries, open the food stores to the sick, and put on the sackcloth before the second winter strikes your crops with hail.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 4 bricks pressed Georgian black tea, 100 razor blades
dispatches.transcript: Harlan: Tea is genuine pre-war black pekoe from a sealed railway freight car in the south marsh. Dry as powder, brews dark as engine oil. The hundred steel razor blades are in grease paper. I took the five bags of salt and the crate of 12-gauge shotgun shells. Next month I want copper wire.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 newborn child registration document
dispatches.transcript: Sister Mara: Please inscribe on the granite roll: 'Dmitri Junior', son of Dmitri the Mechanic and Vera of the Hydroponics Ward. Born Day 1050, weight 3.4 kg. Vigorous cry, clear eyes, ten fingers, ten toes. The mother is resting on wool blankets. The father wept into his toolbox for twenty minutes.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Signed Labor Agreement
dispatches.transcript: TERMS ACCEPTED: 1) Every furnace stoker receives 500ml of fresh goat milk per shift to clear the slag fumes from the lungs. 2) Shifts capped at eight hours when pouring cast iron. 3) Two tallow candles guaranteed per bunk cubicle. In exchange, the furnace fires light at 06:00 tomorrow.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Dive Rigging Checklist
dispatches.transcript: Boys: The ice on the lake is four feet thick. We cut the dive hole using the thermite lance yesterday. I am going down twelve meters to the tanker 'Admiral Nakhimov'. Hold 2 contains four hundred sealed steel barrels of turbine lubricant. Keep the air compressor running at six atmospheres; if the line freezes, haul me up by the lifeline.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 viable winter apple sprout in peat pot
dispatches.transcript: Sonya: Look at this seedling. Sprouted from a seed recovered from the cryogenic repository in Sector 6. It has been hardened in our -5°C cold frame for thirty days and survived with green leaves. By Year 8, we will plant the first orchard on the south slope of Mount Karkov. The soil is waking up.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Voice Broadcast Log
dispatches.transcript: This is Pirate Free-Net 88.4 MHz. Good morning to the coal miners in Sector 7, the divers in the marshes, and the sentries on the frost cupolas. The Tempest Directorate wants you to pay census levy; the Garrison wants you to salute their brass. Don't pay, don't salute. Grow your rye, brew your porter, and love your children.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Grid Frequency Telemetry (50.0 Hz)
dispatches.transcript: GRID SYNCHRONIZATION COMPLETE. The hydro turbines at Lock 4 and Lock 6 are now locked in phase at 50 Hz. Four thousand volts are flowing across the valley on the high aluminum lines. Throw your main switches. Turn on the lights in every street, every workshop, every home. The night is over.

dispatches.goods_manifest: Caravan Report: 12 timber sleds, 40 tons pig iron
dispatches.transcript: Council: Our twelve-sled caravan reached the coast at Port Morozov on Day 3000. We met the Black Flotilla at the outer pier. They traded us ten tons of dried salt cod, three barrels of whale oil, and two boxes of navigation chronometers for our pig iron. The road is open and safe. The sea is alive.

dispatches.goods_manifest: 12 Quarry Slate Slabs (2m x 1m)
dispatches.transcript: To the Stonecutters: You will quarry twelve slabs of dark blue slate from the deep drift in Sector 7. Polish the faces until they reflect the sky like water. Sonya will carve the forty articles of the Valley Constitution. Every district will place one slab in their central square. What is cut in stone shall not be undone by men.

dispatches.recipient: Sonya, President of the Valley of Tessarat
dispatches.goods_manifest: 1 fresh red apple from Sonya's Tree, 1 pouch of wild honey
dispatches.transcript: Sonya: Ten years ago, on Day 18, I carried Yakov's salt sacks through thirty-four below zero with frozen boots and a broken rifle. Today, I walked up the mountain path in my shirtsleeves and picked the first red apple from your tree on Mount Karkov. It is sweet, crisp, and smells of sun. My delivery pouch is empty. The road is done.
